summary: Injured hiker with a broken lower leg evacuated from the S.O.B. Route, Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP; a SPOT locator signal late Friday night triggered the response; an NPS EMT and paramedic spent the night with the Colorado Springs man stabilizing the leg; ~20 rescuers from the park SAR team and Ouray Mountain Rescue hauled him 1,800 ft up loose rock, cliffs and brush via multiple hauling stations over 24+ hours; evacuation completed Saturday evening
location: S.O.B. Route, Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
responding_agency: Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP SAR team; Ouray Mountain Rescue
notes: NPS morning report dated 2013-05-08; SPOT signal 2013-05-03; rescue completed Saturday 2013-05-04
